lines: Julie and her little brother David were in the living room.
Julie thought, "He must have something in his throat."
Julie opened her hand and hit David's back hard.
Finally, a piece of sandwich came out of his mouth.
Just then, Mom came into the living room.
"Thank goodness! You saved David, Julie," Mom said.
"I learned first aid at school," Julie said proudly.
body.text: Julie and her little brother David were in the living room. They were eating sandwiches. Suddenly, David's eyes got wide. His face turned red. "What's the matter?" Julie asked. David could not answer. Soon, his face turned blue. He could not breathe. Julie thought, "He must have something in his throat." Julie opened her hand and hit David's back hard. One, two, three times. Finally, a piece of sandwich came out of his mouth. Just then, Mom came into the living room. "What happened?" Mom asked. Julie told her everything. "Thank goodness! You saved David, Julie," Mom said. "I learned first aid at school," Julie said proudly.
